$comment: Type effectiveness for battles. 'strong' lists the types this type deals extra damage to; weaknesses are derived from it (X is weak to Y when Y lists X as strong). Keeping only one direction in the data makes contradictions impossible. Edit freely â€” engine/battle.js reads this at runtime.

battle.$comment: missChance is the flat chance any attack whiffs. statusChance is the chance a landed hit also inflicts the attacker type's status. Both are deliberately low â€” they should add texture, not decide fights.
battle.$evolveComment: Wins earned while using a starter before it evolves. Only creatures with an evolvesInto in creatures.json can evolve, which today means the nine starters.

status.$comment: One status per attacking type. dot = damage per turn to the afflicted; atkMul scales their attack; skipChance is the chance they lose a turn; drain heals the inflicter for the dot amount. Normal inflicts nothing, which is part of what makes it the plain one.

tiers.$comment: Battle stats and catch difficulty by rarity. `wins` is the [min, max] number of battles needed to earn that creature; like hp and attack, each individual creature sits at a fixed point inside its band, chosen from its own seed. So two wilds are not identical, but every wild is easier than every legendary.
